mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear and 84 degrees at City Hall, with a waning crescent moon overhead, an overnight low of 70, and rain predicted for later tonight.

The City Clerk has concluded public voting for the I Voted sticker contest, which encouraged students to showcase their creativity for the November election, while the Plan Commission prepares to review various local development projects.

We have a full schedule ahead, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a variety of trivia nights tomorrow and throughout the week, plus the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and Concerts in the Park on Wednesday and Thursday respectively.
In a noteworthy update, officers assisted the Dane County Sheriff Office on August 8 after a vehicle rollover where the driver fled the scene, resulting in an O W I arrest.
Make sure to stop by Culvers tonight for their Georgia Peach flavor of the day before they close at 10 PM. It is a fantastic choice to cool off this evening.
